newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines 1997 1st half corn output seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Philippines 1997 1st half corn output seen rising.

text.p: Philippine corn production from January to June this year is expected to rise to 1.844 million tonnes from 1.778 million in the same period last year, the Bureau of Agricultural Statistics said on Monday.

In a report, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters, the department said it expected the country's corn output to improve due to prospects of a larger area of farms planted with corn as an offshoot of the government's corn productivity programme.
The programme, launched by the Department of Agriculture last year, is aimed at improving the country's corn yield through the distribution of better seeds.
The government has also extended credit to farmers and has improved irrigation and other post harvest facilities to corn farms all over the country.

The Bureau of Agricultural Statistics said it expected the area under corn farms to increase to 1.079 million hectares in the first six months of the year from 1.062 million in the same period last year.
Corn yield per hectare is also expected to rise to 1.71 tonnes from 1.67 tonnes.
